s1.desc: a bedroom with a yellow wooden bed with duck-topped bedposts, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: opening POV from inside the bed: black frames f0-4 and f15-19, an eyelid-shaped black vignette opens and closes (blinks) f5-22, then the POV over Polly's head and Pax's flipper un-blurs f22-38. Only slivers of the leads visible

spans.view: with white pillows and a pale blanket, and a beam of sunlight slanting across the bed

beats.text: Pax lies tucked in bed looking ahead with open eyes while Polly snuggles against his cheek with her eyes closed, smiling
Pax closes his eyes with a contented smile while Polly keeps nuzzling his cheek
Pax turns his head and presses a kiss onto Polly's cheek, a blush on his face
Pax faces forward again with wide open eyes while Polly stays snuggled against him with her eyes closed
Pax sits up and scoots to the left edge of the bed while Polly stays lying with her eyes closed and her flippers under her chin

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the bed-foot band scale 1.0000, 0 px at cc 1.000 for f39-119; compare 39/122 background edges overlap. Top-band ECC rows (f55 1.08) are bad fits on the plain sunbeam wall, ignored. No overlays

spans.view: with long curtains hanging from a rod on the back wall, and the end of the bed in the foreground

beats.text: Pax stands at the round window with his back turned and reaches out to grab the curtain
Pax glances back over his shoulder as he drags the curtain across the window, and the sunbeam on the floor fades
Pax holds the closed curtains with one flipper raised, peeking back over his shoulder in the now dim room
Pax lets go and turns around to face forward, then stands with one flipper on his hip and a pleased look

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the bed band scale 1.0000, 0 px at cc 1.000 f127-143; after f147 the fit fails because the room darkens, but compare 123/187 keeps the bed, bedpost knob and curtain rod edges black (overlapping). spans.view: with the curtains drawn and the room dim, and a white pillow behind her

beats.text: Polly sleeps in bed with her eyes closed and her flippers tucked under her chin, smiling softly

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: ECC on the headboard band scale 1.003 at f192 to 1.022 at f210 with a drift of -12 px x, -21 px y; compare 188/211 shows every edge doubled

beats_dropped.text: Pax stands behind the bed in the dim room, blinking and looking around
Pax looks on as the blanket rises off the bed like a long arm and wraps around his flipper
Pax leaps up into the air in fright with his eyes wide and his beak open

spans.notes: 16 frames, wide shot of the whole bed between two nightstands with lamps: Pax lands in bed beside Polly and pulls the blanket over both of them, then they peek out

spans.view: with the curtains drawn and the room dim, and white pillows behind them

beats.text: Pax lies in bed staring ahead with wide eyes and blinks once, while Polly snuggles in against his side with her eyes closed
Pax glances sideways at Polly with wide eyes as she nuzzles his cheek, smiling with her eyes closed
Pax turns toward Polly and puts a flipper around her, closing his eyes as they cuddle
